cells.gaps: The one evidence row, DZA-001, is from the source the study excludes and sets nothing, so no aspect is held. Nothing admissible says whether primary schools keep learner records on paper or in a system, at which levels, or in how many schools.
cells.note: Stage 1 is a claim and needs an admissible dated statement that learner records are on paper only; the only such statement is the excluded source's inference. With no admissible row, no rung can be set.
